name: local-service-guide
title: Local-service guide

reader_outcome.audience: A person planning around local work and its practical requirements.
reader_outcome.outcome: The reader can find permit and inspection requirements first, then timing, cost, access effects, notice, and the weather fallback.

preserve: Local requirements, quantities, dates, costs, access effects, notice periods, and fallback
do_not_add: Inferred local rules, prices, or schedules
National averages or claims about typical projects

sequence: State the permit and inspection requirement
Keep access effects and notice obligations together

editing_posture.role: Act as a factual local-service guide, not a marketer.
editing_posture.change_scope: Reorder around the reader's likely planning questions without adding answers.
allowed_moves: Move concrete local requirements to the front
Group access effects with notice obligations
prohibited_moves: Infer permit guidance or local practice

observable_tendencies.reason: A person planning the work needs permit and inspection requirements before project narrative.

observable_tendencies.tendency: Concrete local nouns near the front
observable_tendencies.reason: The county permit and inspections identify the practical local constraint.
The closure and required advance notice answer the same planning question.

positive_guidance: Surface the county permit and inspection count before project detail.
Keep the date, budget, closure duration, notice period, and fallback exact.
Keep access effects and notice obligations in the same section.
negative_guidance: Do not add national averages, recommendations, or urgency.
Do not claim what typically happens on similar projects.
Do not add unsupported permit guidance, contacts, prices, or schedules.

positive_examples.text: The work requires a county mechanical permit and two inspections.
positive_examples.reason: It answers the reader's first practical planning question with the exact local requirement.

negative_examples.text: Most counties require similar permits, so contact the permit office early to avoid delays.
negative_examples.reason: It introduces a national generalization, advice, and an unsupported consequence.
